text:
maria: Quick decision needed before release: chip vs explicit cluster crumb for compact rail. Tradeoffs: chip keeps breadcrumb short, crumb is explicit for SR users. Thoughts?
eli: Chip is visually tidy but I'm worried about discoverability when the rail is icon-only. If chip is decorative we must ensure the breadcrumb list still exposes cluster for assistive tech.
samir: Accessibility point: do not duplicate visible cluster text and also expose it in the breadcrumb list in a way that confuses SRs. If using a chip, mark it aria-hidden and include cluster as the first list item in the breadcrumb nav with aria-label="Breadcrumb" and aria-current on leaf. Also ensure collapse controls are <button aria-expanded>.
aisha: Copy consideration: whatever we show in the chip/crumb must exactly match the left-rail label. We had mismatches before between "Apps" and "Projects" and it was confusing. I'll run a rapid poll: "Projects" vs "Apps & Jobs" and share results in 2 hours.
tess: Pragmatic idea: ship chip in v1 and run an A/B test where 10% of users get the explicit crumb. Measure task success and time-to-find after landing from permalinks. If crumb cohort performs better, flip.
maria: Good plan. Dev constraints? eli?
eli: Dev note: implement chip as purely decorative (aria-hidden) and add the cluster as the first <li> in the breadcrumb nav. Also add unit tests for highlight priority: exact leaf > section > cluster. I'll also add a compatibility resolver for old permalinks.
samir: Also add keyboard focus tests for compact mode: make sure focus ring is visible on first breadcrumb link and that skip link (#main) is first tabbable element.
aisha: Poll posted. Draft copy A: "Projects". Draft copy B: "Apps & Jobs". Will ping research.
design-bot: [autotest] nav-highlight-priority: failing in compact-icon-only mode on branch left-rail-chip. See https://ci/redwood/3312
maria: Eli, please prioritize the flaky highlight test. Samir, please run the ARIA checklist against the chip prototype. Tess, set up A/B config. I'll run a 15-min sync tomorrow 9:15 PT to confirm. :calendar: 
eli: On it. Starting with tests now.
samir: Running audit this afternoon and will attach keyboard-only recording.
aisha: Poll ends in 2 hours, will report back.
tess: A/B flags ready, will coordinate with eng.
maria: Thanks team. Goal: ship conservative chip + compatibility routes, iterate after A/B data. :+1:
